title: emc2 change request
description: A request to create, update or delete an object or a layer, sent to the object store (ADR-0005). The object store answers with a change event, or with a change rejection. See model/README.md for the update semantics, in particular how extensions are merged. Data model 1.9.0 (PDA).

requestId.description: Correlates the request with its answer: a change event or a change rejection (model rule 12).

entityId.description: Generated by the requester on create.

baseVersion.description: The version the requester based the change on. Recorded but not enforced in version 1 (last write wins); prepared for optimistic locking.

data.description: The new content. Required for create and update, absent for delete.

externalRef.description: Only when creating an object: its identity in an external system. The object store copies it to meta.externalRef (model rule 16).

fields.description: Data model 1.2.0 (ADR-0038). Declared fields to set, only on the create and update of an object. The object store checks each against its declaration (the field exists; it is editable by others, or the requester is its own plugin; the type and limits hold) and applies them after the content: a value sets extensions.<plugin>.<name>, null removes it unless the field is required. Each field once. A failing field rejects the request with VALIDATION_FAILED at /fields/<i>.

value.description: A string, number or boolean as the declaration says; null removes the field.
